title: Côte Sauvage Surf
prompt:
in 5 separate folders, in parallel (one agent each):

    impress-me with a landing-page for a %usecase% using the pmndrs:examples skill

replace `%usecase%` with anything, e.g. "jewelry-boutique" | "arcade-game shop" | "anything_you_find_relevant"

at the end build and open each one in a browser tab
brief: Build an "impress-me" 3D landing page for a Biarritz surf school ("Côte Sauvage Surf") — water / ocean shader / MeshReflectorMaterial / scroll-rig / caustics / godrays.
